title: How to Find Jobs on LinkedIn Before Everyone Else (Cheat Code)
description:
Trying to figure out how to find a job on LinkedIn quickly—but every role already has hundreds of applicants?

In this video, I break down LinkedIn job-search strategies that most people aren’t using.

What you’ll learn:

How to find jobs on LinkedIn posted in the last hour
How to use Boolean search to uncover current hiring activity
How to analyze recently hired candidates and position yourself in the same way
How to identify and connect with people in your target role
How to increase your visibility so you actually get seen

If LinkedIn has felt overwhelming or like you’re applying without hearing anything back, it’s not because you’re not qualified. It’s because you’re not being seen the way you should be, and that is fixable.
